description: Analytical techniques decomposed. NMR variants (1D, 2D, COSY, NOESY), mass spec ionization methods, chromatography variants, X-ray techniques (XRD, XPS, XRF), electron microscopy (SEM, TEM, STEM, EBSD, EDS), surface analysis (AFM, STM), thermal analysis (DSC, TGA).

sub_mechanisms.name: 1D_NMR_chemical_shift
sub_mechanisms.definition: Spectrum with peaks. Chemical shift δ (ppm) ID's environment. Integration counts H.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation of organic ID. Aromatic 6-8 ppm; aliphatic 0-3; -OH variable. Standard.

sub_mechanisms.name: 2D_NMR_COSY_NOESY
sub_mechanisms.definition: COSY: H-H coupling (through bond). NOESY: H-H through space (<5 Å).
sub_mechanisms.why: Structure determination. COSY shows connectivity. NOESY shows 3D proximity. Standard for complex molecules.

sub_mechanisms.name: EI_CI_ESI_MALDI
sub_mechanisms.definition: Mass spec ionization: EI (hard, fragmenting), CI (soft, M+H+), ESI (solution), MALDI (proteins).
sub_mechanisms.why: Choose by analyte. ESI: drugs, peptides. MALDI: proteins, polymers. EI: structure ID via fragments.

sub_mechanisms.name: tandem_mass_spec
sub_mechanisms.definition: MS/MS. Select ion, fragment, mass-spec fragments.
sub_mechanisms.why: Structure determination + sensitivity. Quantification of trace analytes. Proteomics, drug metabolism.

sub_mechanisms.name: HPLC_GC_separation
sub_mechanisms.definition: Stationary + mobile phase. Different distribution coefficients separate.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation of separation. Reverse-phase HPLC (C18 + polar mobile) universal. GC for volatile.

sub_mechanisms.name: GC_MS_LC_MS
sub_mechanisms.definition: Chromatography + mass spec. Separate then identify.
sub_mechanisms.why: Complex mixtures. Environmental, drug screening, metabolomics. Standard combination.

sub_mechanisms.name: XRD_powder_single_crystal
sub_mechanisms.definition: Powder XRD: phase ID, lattice parameter. Single crystal: full atomic structure.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation crystallography. Single crystal: protein structures (Nobels). Powder: ubiquitous QC.

sub_mechanisms.name: XPS_surface_chemistry
sub_mechanisms.definition: X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy. Binding energies → elements + oxidation states. Top ~10 nm.
sub_mechanisms.why: Surface composition. Oxidation states (C1s shift identifies functional groups). Standard surface chemistry tool.

sub_mechanisms.name: EDS_EBSD_in_SEM
sub_mechanisms.definition: Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy: elemental ID via X-rays. EBSD: orientation mapping.
sub_mechanisms.why: Coupled with SEM. Element maps; grain orientation maps. Foundation modern materials characterisation.

sub_mechanisms.name: TEM_STEM_imaging
sub_mechanisms.definition: TEM: 2D image. STEM: scanned probe. Atomic resolution at high accelerations.
sub_mechanisms.why: Defects, interfaces, nanoparticles. Aberration-corrected STEM: atomic columns. Modern materials science.

sub_mechanisms.name: DSC_thermal_analysis
sub_mechanisms.definition: Differential Scanning Calorimetry. Heat flow vs T. Detects Tg, Tm, Tc, reactions.
sub_mechanisms.why: Polymer characterisation, drug formulation, materials. Phase transitions visible. Standard.

sub_mechanisms.name: TGA_thermogravimetric
sub_mechanisms.definition: Mass vs T. Decomposition, dehydration, oxidation steps.
sub_mechanisms.why: Stability + composition. Polymer filler content. Foundation thermal analysis.

derivation_rules.name: NMR_structure_determination_complete
derivation_rules.why: 1D: H count + environment. COSY: connectivity. NOESY: 3D. NMR is most informative single technique for organic structure.

derivation_rules.name: tandem_MS_picograms
derivation_rules.why: Selectivity from precursor + fragment masses; sensitivity from no chemical noise. Drug bioanalysis, doping testing. Foundation.

derivation_rules.name: XPS_oxidation_state_from_binding_energy
if: XPS measures core electron binding energy
derivation_rules.why: Fe²⁺ vs Fe³⁺ shifted ~2 eV. C-C vs C-O vs C=O distinguishable. Standard surface chemistry analysis.

derivation_rules.name: atomic_resolution_TEM_via_aberration_correction
derivation_rules.why: Lens aberrations limit resolution; corrector removes. Modern TEMs: 0.5 Å resolution. Revolutionised materials science.

derivation_rules.name: DSC_TGA_complementary
then: DSC + TGA combined gives complete picture
derivation_rules.why: DSC: phase transitions + reactions. TGA: mass changes (decomp, oxidation). Together: full thermal behaviour. Standard.
